wolfbox-mf70-airduster-kit.description: A bin for the Wolfbox MF70 kit and its accessories.
features: Four fitted pockets for the tool, nozzles, and cable
Shared finger access across the tool and accessory pockets

dewalt-right-angle-tools.description: A bin for DeWalt long and short right-angle adapters and their handle. Leave space above the loaded bin before stacking.
features: Separate pockets at 31 mm and 25 mm depths
One shared finger-access slot across all three tools

ryobi-cutter.description: A fitted bin for the Ryobi cutter with room to lift it out by hand.
features: Two-level pocket with 14 mm and 55 mm depths
Custom 15-cell footprint shaped around the cutter
Finger-access slot for lifting the tool

caliper-storage.description: A bin for calipers, measurement strips, and spare batteries. The loaded bin needs clearance above it.
tools: 50 mm, 100 mm, and 200 mm measurement strips
features: Storage for three strip lengths and three spare coin cells
Separate finger-access openings for the calipers, strips, and batteries

stapler.description: A fitted bin for a stapler. For easier removal, lower the solid fill or add another finger opening before exporting a print.
features: Two-level pocket with 32 mm and 42 mm depths
Finger access at one end

wire-strippers.description: A fitted bin for wire strippers.
features: Shaped outline with a finger-access slot
Editable raised lettering recreated from the print photo

klein-voltage-tester.description: A dedicated bin for a Klein voltage tester.
features: Narrow 1 × 4 Gridfinity footprint
Single fitted pocket with finger access

mouldline-remover.description: A dedicated bin for the Citadel mouldline remover.
features: 17.5 mm-deep fitted tool pocket
Rounded finger-access scoop beside the handle

wiha-drivers.description: A bin for five Wiha precision screwdrivers with 150 mm blades.
tools: Wiha precision screwdrivers with 150 mm blades
features: Five shaped pockets with a shared finger-access opening
Editable raised lettering recreated from the print photo

mini-socket-set.description: A compact bin for a mini ratchet, sockets, and driver bits.
features: Reuses the socket set’s original pre-cut tool insert
A single rectangular recess holds the entire insert

wiha-40mm-drivers.description: A compact bin for four Wiha precision screwdrivers with 40 mm blades.
tools: Wiha precision screwdrivers with 40 mm blades
features: Linked pockets hold all four drivers facing the same direction
Shared finger access in a half-pitch footprint

wiha-50mm-drivers.description: A bin for a Wiha slotted driver and Phillips driver, both with 50 mm blades.
features: Two linked pockets align the drivers in the same direction
One finger-access opening serves both drivers

wiha-60mm-drivers.description: A bin for a Wiha slotted driver and Phillips driver, both with 60 mm blades.
features: Linked pockets with shared finger access
Editable raised Wiha lettering, with a separate color part in the 3MF

bessey-gerber.description: A shared Gridfinity bin for a closed Bessey folding utility knife and a Gerber multitool.
features: Side-by-side pockets at different depths, 9.78 mm and 16.28 mm
Long rounded finger-access opening between the pockets

bessey-utility-knife.description: A separate bin for the closed Bessey D-BKWH folding knife.
features: One fitted knife pocket with a finger-access opening across it
Compact half-pitch footprint

gerber-multitool.description: A separate bin for the closed Gerber multitool.
features: One fitted multitool pocket with a finger-access opening across it
Compact half-pitch footprint

craftsman-tape-measure.description: A fitted bin for a Craftsman 25-foot tape measure with a belt clip.
features: 16 mm-deep body pocket and deeper 22 mm belt-clip relief
Editable raised label and multicolor print model

detailPhotos.caption: Belt clip on the back of the tape measure
